summary: Setting up the external tamper alarm no longer needs database rights.

new.title: Download the alarm inputs on Tamper
new.text: Admins and SuperAdmins can download one file from the Tamper page with everything the external Azure Monitor alarm needs. The alarm setup now builds from that file.
new.action: After you change break-glass accounts, watched tags or known writers, download a fresh file on the Tamper page and set up the alarm again.
